extra_vocab.en: a document that shows the money paid in and out of an account
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，card statement 是信用卡對帳單。Prasanna 請 Mr. Yang 查看對帳單上有沒有收到退款。

example.en: Please send us your bank statements for the last three months.
example.zh: 請寄給我們你最近三個月的銀行對帳單。

example.en: Please attach a copy of your latest bank statement.
example.zh: 請附上你最新銀行對帳單的影本。

example.en: A monthly statement is emailed to every customer on the first.
example.zh: 月結對帳單會在每個月一號寄給每位客戶。

example.en: The manager will make a statement about the new policy tomorrow.
example.zh: 經理明天會針對新政策發表聲明。

examples.en: I checked the statement, but I could not find the refund.
examples.zh: 我查看了對帳單，但找不到那筆退款。

examples.en: The statement lists every payment made during the month.
examples.zh: 對帳單列出了這個月所有已付的款項。

examples.en: Please check your statement before you call the billing office.
examples.zh: 打電話給帳務部門前，請先查看你的對帳單。

confusable.diff: state 當動詞是「說明、陳述」；statement 是名詞，指「聲明」或「對帳單」。
confusable.usage: state 是動詞，後面直接接受詞（state your name）；statement 是名詞，前面可加 a、the 或形容詞。

example.en: Please state your name and account number clearly.
example.zh: 請清楚說出你的姓名與帳號。

example.en: The bill arrives at the end of every month.
example.zh: 帳單每個月底會寄到。

example.en: Keep the receipt in case you need a refund.
example.zh: 請保留收據，以防需要退款。

example.en: Please pay the invoice within thirty days of receiving it.
example.zh: 請在收到發票後三十天內付款。

derived.link: state 是「說明」，加 -ment 變成名詞，像 pay → payment、agree → agreement

senses.en: a document showing money paid in and out of an account

example.en: Your account statement shows two payments made in October.
example.zh: 你的帳戶對帳單顯示十月有兩筆付款。

senses.distinguish: 後面常搭配 issue、release、make 這類動詞，或出現在新聞與公司公告時，是「聲明」。

example.en: The CEO issued a statement about the merger yesterday.
example.zh: 執行長昨天針對合併案發表了聲明。

extra_vocab.en: a message or act that says something is true or agreed
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，Mr. Yang 問該怎麼把確認給對方。Prasanna 回答直接在電話中口頭確認就可以，因為案件需要他的確認才能結案。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: confirmation of + 事物 表示「…的確認」（confirmation of your order）；常搭配 give、send、receive、request 等動詞。

example.en: We received two confirmations from the hotel on the same day.
example.zh: 我們在同一天收到飯店寄來的兩封確認信。

example.en: You will get a confirmation email after you pay.
example.zh: 付款後你會收到一封確認信。

example.en: Please keep your confirmation number for future questions.
example.zh: 請保留確認編號，以便日後詢問。

example.en: We need written confirmation before we can change the booking.
example.zh: 我們需要書面確認才能更改訂位。

examples.en: Please send me confirmation that the order has been shipped.
examples.zh: 請寄給我訂單已出貨的確認。

examples.en: I am waiting for confirmation from the billing team.
examples.zh: 我正在等帳務團隊的確認。

examples.en: The hotel gave us confirmation of the room reservation.
examples.zh: 飯店給了我們房間預訂的確認。

similar.diff: verification 強調查證資料或身分是否正確；confirmation 強調確認某事屬實或同意。

example.en: Identity verification may take up to two business days.
example.zh: 身分查證最多可能需要兩個工作天。

similar.diff: approval 是「核准、同意」，由有權的人決定；confirmation 只是確認事實。

example.en: The refund needs approval from the finance manager first.
example.zh: 這筆退款需要先經過財務經理核准。

example.en: I will send a reply as soon as I hear from them.
example.zh: 一收到他們的消息我就會回覆。

example.en: You will get a notice when the order is ready.
example.zh: 訂單準備好時你會收到通知。

derived.link: confirm 是基礎動詞；加 -ation 變成名詞，像 inform → information
re- 再次 + confirm，像 review、return 的 re-

extra_vocab.en: a short statement of the main points
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，Prasanna 說結案後會用電子郵件寄一份案件摘要，內容是這次處理過程的重點。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: summary 後面接 of + 內容（a summary of the case），表示「…的摘要」；是可數名詞，單數要加 a 或 the。

example.en: The reports include summaries of each department's results.
example.zh: 這些報告包含各部門成果的摘要。

example.en: Please read the executive summary before the board meeting.
example.zh: 董事會議前請先閱讀執行摘要。

example.en: Can you give me a brief summary of yesterday's meeting?
example.zh: 你可以簡短地跟我說明昨天會議的摘要嗎？

example.en: In summary, the project will finish on time and under budget.
example.zh: 總結來說，專案會準時完成且不超出預算。

examples.en: The manager asked for a summary of the sales results.
examples.zh: 經理要求提供銷售成果的摘要。

examples.en: She wrote a one-page summary after the meeting ended.
examples.zh: 會議結束後，她寫了一頁的摘要。

examples.en: You will receive a summary of the case by email.
examples.zh: 你會透過電子郵件收到案件的摘要。

confusable.diff: summit 是「峰會、山頂」；summary 是「摘要」，兩字開頭拼法相似。

example.en: The leaders will attend a summit in Taipei next month.
example.zh: 各國領袖下個月將出席在台北舉行的峰會。

similar.diff: overview 是對整體的概覽，範圍較廣；summary 是把已有內容濃縮成重點。

example.en: The guide gives a quick overview of the refund process.
example.zh: 這份指南快速概述了退款流程。

similar.diff: recap 較口語，常指口頭或簡短的回顧。

example.en: Let me do a quick recap before we end the call.
example.zh: 結束通話前，讓我快速回顧一下。

example.en: Please send the monthly report to the manager.
example.zh: 請把月報寄給經理。

example.en: She wrote a short outline of the presentation first.
example.zh: 她先寫了簡報的簡短大綱。

derived.link: summary + -ize，變成動詞「做摘要」，像 organize、realize

extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，Mr. Yang 用 Is this call related to the refund? 先確認來電目的，語氣直接、簡單，是電話中常見的確認問法。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: related to 的 to 是介系詞，後面接名詞或 V-ing；不要寫成 related with。

examples.en: Is your question related to billing or technical support?
examples.zh: 你的問題是與帳務有關還是與技術支援有關？

examples.en: Please send all documents related to this order.
examples.zh: 請寄出所有與這筆訂單有關的文件。

examples.en: The delay is related to a problem at the factory.
examples.zh: 這次延誤與工廠的問題有關。

examples.en: Do you have experience in a job related to marketing?
examples.zh: 你有與行銷相關工作的經驗嗎？

similar.diff: regarding 是介系詞，較正式，常放在信件開頭，後面直接接名詞。

example.en: I am writing regarding your order from last week.
example.zh: 我寫信是想詢問你上週的訂單。

similar.diff: have to do with 較口語，常用在疑問句或否定句。

example.en: Does this issue have to do with the new software?
example.zh: 這個問題和新軟體有關嗎？

confusable.diff: relevant to 強調「切題、有用」；related to 只表示有關聯。

example.en: Please include only information relevant to this project.
example.zh: 請只放入與這個專案切題的資訊。

confusable.diff: relative to 是「相對於、與…相比」，用來比較。

example.en: Costs are low relative to the quality of the service.
example.zh: 相對於服務品質，成本算低。
